item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows Rumi's four-sided card, tilted on the page. Every side is $4\,\mathrm{cm}$, and every corner is $90^\circ$.

Which claim correctly names the figure?

options.A: A square, because all sides are equal and all angles are $90^\circ$, even though the card is tilted.
options.B: A rectangle only, because any four-sided shape with right angles is called a rectangle.
options.C: A square, because the four sides are equal.
options.D: Not a square, because tilting the card is what changes its side lengths and angles.
